title: StatusEvent
description: One row in the append-only history of a status page component's state changes. A row is written only when a component's state changes, plus the boot-gap pair for the hub. The duration of a state is the gap to the next row of the same component and is never stored. The hub prunes rows older than 90 days. A component with no rows is treated as operational since the earliest row of any component; this is a display rule, not enforceable in the schema.

at.description: When the component entered this state.

source.description: sample: the hub's periodic check saw it; boot_gap: written at boot to record the hub itself was not running; maintenance: derived from a scheduled window.

detail.description: Plain words with no technical detail.
